description: List persons (contacts) from Pipedrive with optional filtering by owner, organization, or first letter of name.

custom_fields.description: Include custom fields in response (comma-separated field keys or 'all')

include_fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields (v2 enum, e.g. next_activity_id, open_deals_count, won_deals_count, notes_count, followers_count)

updated_since.description: Filter persons updated after this time (RFC3339 format)

updated_until.description: Filter persons updated before this time (RFC3339 format)

name: pipedrive_list_persons
